decisions.reason: The Big Block removal does not itself remove Small Block tickets, but the statement that every community member has an equal chance conflicts with ticket-weighted odds and does not clarify whether Small Block tickets cease weighting, remain as unweighted entries, or are otherwise redesigned.

Chainlink VRF remains applicable to the surviving prize draw, but the equal-chance statement may replace ticket-weighted selection and broaden eligibility; the source does not define whether everyone means all community members or only eligible ticket holders.
The FAQ still describes Big Block prizes and tickets and a $4 founder share, so the explicit Big Block removal and new $5/$5/$5 primary-mint split require corresponding content changes.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey [FREELANCER_NAME_001], I’d like to remove the big blocks and redirect that extra $1 to me, making the split:
$15 buy, $5 to me, $5 to affiliate, $5 to block prize pool.

This improves my bottom line while having minimal effect on sales.
It also makes the game mechanics and marketing simpler.

An even split between me and every community member, together with everyone having an equal chance at the never-ending $500 prizes, seems consistent with the project’s ethos.

value_updates.buyer_earnings: Explain the instant $5 commission and Small Block prize tickets, while stating that any future governance-token allocation depends on FAMM succeeding and has no guarantee of success or value.
value_updates.referral_operation: Explain that each NFT mint number is its permanent referral code, successful referred mints award $5 plus one Small Block ticket, and no-referral mints allocate the commission and Small Block ticket to a random existing NFT holder.

block_prizes.small_block: 5 × $500 approximately every 500 mint or secondary sales
block_prizes.pool_funding: Every sale continues funding the Small Block prize pool.

value_updates.prize_tickets: Explain that each successful referral awards one Small Block ticket, more tickets produce more chances to win, tickets expire after the applicable Small Block draw, and later referrals apply to subsequent Small Blocks.
value_updates.single_level_and_founder_share: Explain that referrals are single-level, source is verified on Basescan, and each $15 primary mint allocates $5 to the founder, $5 to the affiliate, and $5 to the Small Block prize pool.

decisions.reason: The surviving primary-mint split retains the existing $5 direct referral commission, so its amount, recipient, trigger, timing, and automatic payout remain unchanged.

The recurring $500 Small Block prize remains, but the phrase every community member has an equal chance may broaden winner eligibility beyond current affiliates; the source does not define the precise eligible population.
A complete same-message MODIFY already removes the obsolete big_block_ticket_counter_visible attribute while preserving the Small Block counter, badges, and referral-code metadata.
A complete same-message MODIFY already records the $15 primary-mint split as $5 to the founder, $5 to the affiliate, and $5 to the Small Block prize pool.
This Requirement already applies only to the Small Block context, and the source does not change how a no-referral Small Block ticket recipient is selected.
With Big Blocks removed, secondary royalties can no longer fund a Big Block pool, so the existing generic prize-pools destination must be narrowed to the remaining Small Block prize pool.

process_copy.heading: Mint the ebook NFT
process_copy.body: Buy your ebook NFT for $15 USD. The mint number you receive becomes your referral code.

process_copy.heading: Earn Through Referrals
process_copy.body: Share either your mint number or your link. Whenever someone mints with it, you immediately earn $5 USD. There are no limits and no expiration. If no code is provided, the $5 and a Small Block ticket are awarded to a random existing ticket holder.

process_copy.heading: Build Up Tickets
process_copy.body: Every referral also awards you a Small Block prize ticket for the current block. More referrals means more tickets and greater chances.

process_copy.heading: Enter the Prize Draws
process_copy.body: Small Block awards 5 × $500 every 500 sales. Sales include mint and secondary sales. Chainlink VRF selects winners randomly and fairly.

process_copy.heading: Receive Your Rewards
process_copy.body: Commissions are delivered automatically on-chain. Prize wins are posted on the Winners page and can be claimed with one click.

decisions.reason: The generic transfer and expiration rules remain applicable to surviving Small Block tickets and do not retain any Big-Block-specific attribute.
